chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
"Anything for which fasting causes harm, then breaking the fast is obligatory for him."

key_terms.الصَّوْمُ: fasting; the religious fast being observed

ai.seo_question: When does fasting become forbidden or require a person to break the fast due to harm?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that when fasting causes harm to a person, breaking the fast becomes obligatory rather than merely permissible. It highlights that in Islamic law, preservation from harm takes precedence in cases of illness or bodily injury during sawm (fasting).
